title: 札幌記念の後に・Home Straight

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Why are you thanking me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Because it was such a fun race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: All I've done is rely on you up until now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But after running against you like this today, I was able to see you in a different light. That made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of expressing the same sentiment. If this is enough to satisfy you, then I'm disappointed, frankly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your avarice runs deeper than that, does it not? There's still time—pray that we can meet on the turf once again.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If you truly pine for me, I'll show you an even more impressive performance than today.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …! Right, I'll give it some thought!

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highness! There's a call from your sister.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …! Your sister?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's older sister is an exceptional Umamusume who is currently competing all over the globe. I know her only by reputation.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Her Highness wishes to speak with Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, Air Groove is her favorite. Do you mind, Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't put her through! Tell her I've already gone home!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear… I'm terribly sorry, Captain, but could you tell my sister that Groove is unavailable?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: …Um, actually, she said she'd like to speak to your trainer instead if that were to be the case.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Yes, hello there? Are you the trainer responsible for my dear little princess?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Are you frightened? That's a shame—I prefer strong-willed types. One must hold back when dealing with the meek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My first impression of Fine Motion's sister is that she has a… unique personality.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: A let-down to be sure, but I don't doubt you can get the job done. Now, let's get to the heart of the matter.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: There's something I absolutely must say to you. And that is… thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: I made the decision to pursue a racing career from an early age. As such, my dear sister was left to shoulder the duties I left behind.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: She would claim she shoulders them of her own volition, but deep down, I've always harbored some guilt—I essentially locked that innocent young girl away in the castle by my own hand.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Which is why, now, seeing her running so freely in Japan… I feel a weight lifted from my own shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Thank you for enabling her to express her true feelings and explore the wider world.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: I trust you'll continue to take good care of her in the future as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey, what is she saying? Can I hear?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Hehe, is that the chirping of my little dove I hear? Could you put Fine Motion on?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hello, dear sister! Thank you for that passionate letter you sent the other day. It was very touching.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Mere words hardly sufficed to capture my love for you… Oh! I've finally succeeded in running half the world's circumference.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I never doubted you for a moment! Were those spots on the paper from sweat, then? I thought perhaps you had spilled some tea.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Why, they were from the tears I shed longing for your company, of course. …Though, there might be some Assam tea mixed in there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This peculiar back and forth between Fine Motion and her sister continues for some time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before we can return to summer camp from Hokkaido, something unexpected occurs.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Fine! Is it true that you're quitting racing?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …! Captain?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: …I've confirmed the situation. It appears that information pertaining to our recent meeting about your return home somehow leaked.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: … Well, I suppose the truth was going to get out eventually.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's true. After this year, I will be returning to Ireland to carry out my family's duties.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: No way! You mean we'll never get to see you race again?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I am truly grateful for all the support and encouragement you've given me until now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I have… one last request for you all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Please do watch my final race. I would like to—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: No. I definitely will carve a space for myself in your hearts.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So please… Will you come watch me?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: …! Fine…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'll be holding a press conference to provide further details. For now… farewell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps stunned by Fine Motion's sincerity, the fans watch in silence as we leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After returning to the summer campgrounds, I decide that now is the time to speak to Fine Motion about her next race.
choice_data_list: This next one could be your final race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …I know.
choice_data_list: I've narrowed it down to four options.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've taken the time and rank of the races into consideration and, more importantly, I've weighed them by whether the opponents might make her last race a truly enjoyable one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've landed on the autumn Tenno Sho, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, the Mile Championship, and the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: … Just checking, but… theoretically, I could enter all of them, couldn't I?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's just that you'd like me to choose one final race to take on in peak condition?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …Could I have a little time to think about it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: One day should be enough. I just need to… sort out my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wonder if she plans to shoulder this decision alone again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to have faith and leave things in her hands.
